content.headline: The Voices Steering African Progress
content.subhead: Leading urban planners and logistics experts are redefining transit reliability with Bluetone's autonomous ecosystem.

testimonials.name: Amara Okafor
testimonials.title: Chief Urban Planner
testimonials.quote: Bluetone did not just bring technology; they brought a solution that respects the city's pulse while ensuring every citizen has a seat in the future.
testimonials.image_prompt: High-end professional business portrait of a Nigerian woman in a modern Lagos office setting, wearing a tailored navy blazer, soft natural lighting, 8k resolution, cinematic quality.

testimonials.name: Kofi Mensah
testimonials.title: Director of Logistics
testimonials.quote: Our last-mile delivery efficiency tripled overnight. The autonomous fleet navigates our complex local regulations with incredible precision and safety.
testimonials.image_prompt: Executive headshot of a middle-aged Ghanaian man in a light grey business suit, blurred high-tech logistics center in the background, confident expression, professional studio lighting.

testimonials.name: Zanele Mbeki
testimonials.title: Sustainability Lead
testimonials.quote: The transition to electric was about more than carbon footprints; it was about building a reliable, dignified commute that serves the people.
testimonials.image_prompt: Professional portrait of a South African woman leader, outdoor urban setting with modern green architecture, corporate attire with subtle traditional jewelry, daylight, high-fidelity.

testimonials.name: Jean-Paul Ndiaye
testimonials.title: Minister of Infrastructure
testimonials.quote: Bluetone has bridged the gap between cutting-edge innovation and our specific regional requirements, creating a sustainable model for the entire continent.
testimonials.image_prompt: Distinguished Senegalese man in a charcoal suit, studio headshot, neutral background with soft bokeh, executive presence, sharp focus, high-end photography.
